# v1.3.2 - automatic captions work again
Automatic captions in DubForge broke for everyone who installed speech recognition after 29 September. This release fixes that.

### Fixed

- **"Generate captions" failed** with *open() got an unexpected keyword
  argument 'metadata_errors'*. PyAV 19, a library faster-whisper uses to read
  audio, dropped an argument that faster-whisper still passes. DubForge now
  decodes the audio with its own ffmpeg, so captions no longer depend on it,
  and new installs keep PyAV below 19.

### Updating

- **Installed with the setup:** run `DubStage-Setup-1.3.2.exe` below over your
  existing installation, or use the update banner in the app — the app-side fix
  alone is enough for captions to work again.
- **Running from source:** update, then
  `py -m pip install -r requirements-transcription.txt`.

Full history in [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md).
